environment.runtime: real API / PostgreSQL checkpoint and commerce stores; in-process background execution, not independent Worker capacity acceptance

artifacts.note: Isolated QA application/API20882, not the portfolio APK/API20881. All final selected cases use this same main APK.

fixes.cause: A new offer.find reused an expired persisted demo quote; a visible product card hid a FAILED run with no offers event.
fixes.change: New offer.find explicitly obtains a fresh demo quote. Cached read/restore expiry and manual requote boundaries remain unchanged.
fixes.red: PostgreSQL regression failed: offer is expired
fixes.green: 22 PostgreSQL integration tests passed; native tests now require visible terminal completion and COMPLETED database rows.

fixes.cause: Material3 surface-container colors inherited lavender outside the approved cream palette.
fixes.change: Explicit Bone/Surface container tokens; no art-direction change.

fixes.cause: At 200% font, selected-comparison header and nested summary clipped the secondary candidate Ask CTA.
fixes.change: Compact one-line selection hint/title summary, Ask CTA outside clipped summary, compact selection label. Font scaling and vertical paging retained.
fixes.green: Native checks assert displayed/enabled/clickable/unclipped bounds and exercise primary/secondary/tertiary paging and returning selection.

fixes.cause: Local Room/DataStore pending-run snapshots could overwrite currentRunId/currentCursor and start a recovered observer while an explicitly accepted SSE stream already owned the run.
fixes.change: Local snapshot recovery/approval takeover is skipped during explicit submission or an active stream; local list/consent data still updates. Actual cold-start recovery remains available when no stream owns the run.
fixes.intermediate_rejected_fix: Moving run assignment only into stream-resume branch broke both existing approval tests; that intermediate fix was corrected before installation.
fixes.green: 46 Android unit tests passed, including stale-run ownership and both original approval boundary tests. Final native exploration requires visible completion before end-state screenshots.

harness_corrections: Earlier native-only passes are not business acceptance; final cases require completed UI state and every current database Run COMPLETED.

Collector HTTP reads caused observed 429 contamination; final readback is direct read-only PostgreSQL, with a separately declared 600/minute QA limiter. Production remains 60/minute and is not rate-policy tested here.
Lazy-list offscreen nodes must be reached by actual parent/child scrolling, not waiting for an uncomposed button. Saved detail and archived history waits corrected.
Shared ADB returned 255 once before JUnit completed; the same invocation now leaves an on-device JUnit receipt. No test is silently restarted.
Compose PixelCopy produced blank/wrong-window images and one capture failure; final authoritative images use native UiAutomation full-screen captures after idle.
Exploration conclusions can precede the final SSE event; final C6 checks scroll to the visible completion receipt before capturing the conclusion.

known_gaps.title: Cross-Mission waiting-cart presentation still depends on the active Mission quote collection
known_gaps.cause: EditorialDecisionScreen derives waitingGroups from state.cartGroups. ContinueSaved starts a new ShoppingUiState; waiting data/quotes are no longer presented even though PostgreSQL cart rows remain.
known_gaps.acceptance: Add to waiting cart, continue a new Mission with no recommendations, and restart: the global waiting view must still present the persisted items or explicitly show unresolved quote references, never a false empty cart. No silent requote or expiry extension.
known_gaps.scope_note: Final C4 accepts save/open/facts/explicit add/continue/remove and C4b accepts same-Mission restart. Those passes do not close this cross-Mission gap.

known_gaps.title: Direct batch comparison of multiple saved candidates
known_gaps.scope_note: ContinueSaved opens an independent task draft; this is not direct saved-item batch comparison.

known_gaps.title: Full Figma state parity, TalkBack, physical device and paid-provider scenarios
known_gaps.scope_note: This run covers declared capability paths and 100%/200% font on one emulator, not all 14 design states, full accessibility traversal or real-model quality.

regression_checks.command: ruff check --select F scripts/verify_android_decision_ux.py scripts/emulator_recovery_backend.py; python -m compileall -q (same files)

regression_checks.initial_cause: Verification status enum and manifest external_gates drift; corrected metadata, not product behavior. Final check passed.

regression_checks.note: LF/CRLF conversion warnings are separate from whitespace errors.

evidence_policy.authoritative_screenshots: Only the final selected case/label paths below are authoritative; raw attempt folders can contain copies of older screenshots.
evidence_policy.scope: App/API/domain/DB integration with fake planning. No physical-device, MinIO/Qdrant capacity, paid-provider, release or whole-product acceptance.
evidence_policy.auxiliary_capture_limit: Auxiliary restart screenshots can show the compositor's previous transition frame. They are not curated or used to sign off a completed recovery view. Restart acceptance uses native semantic assertions plus independent PostgreSQL readback; only the seven reviewed core-state images above support visual claims.
